claim: As of 12/18/2025 Amazon ECS lets you configure Amazon EC2 event windows for your Fargate tasks to control the exact timing of task retirements, and an event window takes precedence over the task retirement wait time configuration.
question: Can you choose when Fargate retires your tasks?

values.display: configure Amazon EC2 event windows for your Fargate tasks
it takes precedence over your task retirement wait time configuration

qualifiers.condition: applies to retirements scheduled in the future

evidence.quote: As of 12/18/2025, Amazon ECS enables you to configure [Amazon EC2 event windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/event-windows.html) for your Fargate tasks.
Furthermore, when you configure an Amazon EC2 event window for your Fargate tasks, it takes precedence over your task retirement wait time configuration.
